Docs / Overview
Current repository docs

Understand the machine before you embed it.

These docs describe what this checkout actually ships: a Rust RV64 machine compiled to WebAssembly, the browser loader around it, and the guest-side paths that have evidence. Each subject has its own page. Detailed implementation records remain in the repository source docs linked from those pages.

source-backed host libraries are separate planned work is labeled

Scope boundary. The published @agent-wasm/* libraries are host-side packages from a separate repository. This repository's wasm module is generated and served as a relative asset by the demo; it is not documented here as an installable @wasm-vm/* npm package.

Embed the machine

Use startLinuxBoot for a browser Linux controller, or the lower-level WasmMachine wrapper for a bare-metal ELF.
